items.title: IBM (IBM) Stock Could Trade At A Discount After Quantum Computing News
items.summary: International Business Machines has delivered a 5 year share price that puts a lot of history into today’s US$254.32 quote, which raises a simple but hard question for investors: Is the current valuation of IBM really in step with the cash the business is expected to generate over time? Over the past 5 years, International Business Machines has returned 152.8%, which puts a spotlight on whether the cash flow profile has evolved enough to carry that kind of move.
